subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should issue #35203 stay open as the umbrella RFC while maintainers split Layer 1-4 work into narrower core/plugin/API decisions, or should the broad collaboration stack be redirected out of core as not planned?
rationale: The request would define permanent product boundaries for multi-agent routing, shared state, memory visibility, cost admission, and security policy, which automation cannot safely choose from source evidence alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split layers
options.body: Keep this RFC open for design context while making #42475, #65403, identity/memory, and capability-manifest issues the actionable implementation tracks.

options.title: Plugin/API-first boundary
options.body: Keep only missing generic SDK or gateway hooks in core and require optional blackboard/orchestration behavior to ship as plugins or ClawHub packages.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close this broad core RFC if maintainers decide it conflicts with the lean-core roadmap and should not be pursued upstream.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split layers
recommendation.body: Keep this RFC open for design context while making #42475, #65403, identity/memory, and capability-manifest issues the actionable implementation tracks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current blame on central agent/runtime code and scoping comments on adjacent multi-agent RFCs.
